rule: The 34.11 champion/challenger rule replayed on 13 time-ordered real tables (36 decisions): of 27 promotions 2 were worse in the future (7.4%, under the 1 in 10 bar), but of 9 champions kept 5 had a better challenger (55.6%, over the half bar): the rule needs work: too careful. Always promoting did as well or better here (binary 0.0178 against 0.0135, regression 0.0565 against 0.0556).
limits: 13 tables, few distinct sources: every number with its count; a change to the rule is its own package, confirmed on other tables first.
